title: Fractal Schrödinger Convergence Above Half Dimension
exact_target: For $d/2<\alpha\leq d$, determine the sharp exponent $s(\alpha)$ such that every $f\in H^s(\mathbb R^d)$ satisfies $e^{it\Delta}f(x)\to f(x)$ as $t\to0$ for $\mathcal H^\alpha$-almost every $x$.
